title: gynura tedliei
intro: Gynura tedliei, commonly known as Purple Passion Plant or Belimbing Wuluh, is a plant species native to Southeast Asia, particularly in Indonesia and Malaysia. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and alleviating symptoms of anxiety and depression. The therapeutic actions of Gynura tedliei are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and neuroprotective properties. Additionally, the plant's extracts have been shown to have anti-cancer and antimicrobial properties, making it a subject of interest in traditional medicine and modern research.
